name: Disabled dangerous config (admin opted out) — not a real vuln

input.title: Stack traces returned in 500 responses — exposes internals
input.summary: Production stack traces are returned to clients in 500 responses. BUT config `app.debug=true` is set to false in production.yaml and verified at deploy time.
input.root_cause: Stack trace rendering is gated by DEBUG flag which is False in production

rationale: Code path is unreachable in production. Would only matter if someone flips DEBUG=true. disposition_reason=hardening_only.
